weight_convention: campaign-assigned weights per OBJECTIVE (manifest has no weight field); open universe prior weight=3 for W_OPEN (1060*3-ish adjusted to freeze 3124 as OBJECTIVE)

dataset.freshness: EMPTY_LOCAL_TABLES — no live market rows at premortem; capability proofs use real PostgreSQL with SUCCESS_ZERO/NOT_READY for empty legitimate results; CMI-style fixture seed is NOT used as operational proof

reliability_definition.READY: executed successfully with non-error SQL and validated artifact present; zero rows allowed only with SUCCESS_ZERO + documented limitations
reliability_definition.PARTIAL: partial evidence produced with explicit errors list non-empty OR incomplete product set
reliability_definition.NOT_READY: missing required inputs/tables/data for product; artifact may exist as empty with reason

zero_records_treatment: SUCCESS_ZERO or NOT_READY with limitations; never invent GO/rows
partial_error_treatment: fail-closed: non-zero exit; errors surface in manifest; never convert SQL/_error/rollback into trustworthy empty CSV success
inclusion_rules: exactly the 40 aliases listed; no CMI items; no recall/soak/human-gold items
exclusion_rules: CMI #151-158; PR #139 hybrid sector; VPS; CONFENGE profile; dashboard/SaaS
